name: l71-shieldlock-shut
description: THE POSITIVE CONTROL for l71-shieldlock-open, and the reason that fixture is evidence rather than a description. It is the SAME TAPE with ONE FIELD CHANGED: grants is empty, so Player.hasDarkShield is false and ShieldLock.update's condition ((hasDarkShield && shieldType == 1) || (hasShield && shieldType == 0)) is simply false — not slower, false. The lock is then an ordinary 16x16 Solid, and the game answers by pinning the player against its west face at x 285.95 for all 140 ticks, at y 264 rather than 263 because nothing ever snapped them, in level 71 rather than 76 because nothing ever opened. Without this, 'the player got through' is satisfied by a lock that was never there — the same vacuity l71-lock-shut closes for R2's button hold. The 100-tick gap in the input spans is inert here and kept deliberately: two tapes that differ in exactly one field are a claim about that field, and a shorter control would have been a claim about two.
